title.ko: 철학과 사상: it follows that · by definition · a case in point · presuppose
title.en: philosophy and ideas: it follows that, by definition, a case in point, presuppose

explain.ko: 철학적 글은 전제, 추론, 결론의 구조를 분명히 하는 것이 핵심입니다. 전제는 presuppose, assume, take for granted로, 추론은 it follows that, hence, thus로, 사례는 a case in point, for instance로, 정의는 by definition으로 표현합니다. 반론은 One might object that ... 으로 도입하고 If ... then ... 구조로 논리를 보입니다. 추상적인 개념은 구체적인 사례로 뒷받침하세요.
explain.en: Philosophical writing depends on a clear structure of premise, inference and conclusion. Premises use presuppose, assume, take for granted; inference uses it follows that, hence, thus; examples use a case in point, for instance; definition uses by definition. Introduce objections with One might object that ... and show logic with If ... then .... Support abstract concepts with concrete examples.

lines.t: In philosophy, it is important to identify an argument's premises. If the premises are true and the logic valid, the conclusion is true. But when premises are hidden, arguments easily go wrong. So we should always ask what is being presupposed.

items.passage:
ESSAY
The limits of moral intuition
We often judge right and wrong by intuition. But intuition varies with culture and experience. It follows that moral intuition alone cannot establish universal principles.

task.model: All moral responsibility presupposes free will. It follows that if there is no free will, no one can be blamed. The legal treatment of mentally ill defendants is a case in point. However, determinists may object that free will is an illusion.

model_trans.ko: 모든 도덕적 책임은 자유 의지를 전제합니다. 따라서 자유 의지가 없다면 누구도 비난받을 수 없다는 결론이 나옵니다. 정신 질환자에 대한 법적 판단이 그 좋은 사례입니다. 그러나 결정론자는 자유 의지가 환상이라고 반박할 수 있습니다.
model_trans.en: All moral responsibility presupposes free will. It follows that if there is no free will, no one can be blamed. The legal treatment of mentally ill defendants is a case in point. However, determinists may object that free will is an illusion.
